'''Popagrind''' is a [[Rock]] type [[Tank]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Popapouch]] at 18 stars, and evolves into [[Popafam]] at 36 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "Whenever Popagrind hits the streets carrying the lil' ones, passing males would all turn to look. But this is nothing. Being a parent doesn't cost you your dignity, only your sleep- and raising two babies just makes the loss more complete."

Popagrind is a red rarity Tatari.

== Evolution Trial ==
Popagrind's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 36 stars. To evolve it into [[Popafam]] you need to complete the following three tasks:

* Feed this Tatari to B quality.
* Play [[Treasure Hunt]] (Dig up treasure x120) or [[Cozy Farm]] (Use Fertilizer x7,200).
* Obtain 15 more Popa Tatari via any means.

== Trivia ==
* Popagrind and its evolutions were added to the game on 10/72026 alongside [[Cactobodhi]] and [[Armavolve]].
